# Teal design system

> Documentation for @kryv/teal v0.4.1 - typed React modules, semantic design tokens, and tested interaction behavior for Kryv applications.

## Start

- [Getting started](/): installation, Tailwind preset, fonts, and theming.
- [Foundations](/foundations): semantic color, typography, shape, and motion tokens.
- [Changelog](/changelog): versioned changes to @kryv/teal.

## Modules

- [Button](/modules/button) (Actions): Actions with consistent hierarchy, sizing, loading, and accessible icon treatment.
- [Button Group](/modules/button-group) (Actions): An attached cluster of related actions with hairline seams and shared corner radius.
- [Segmented Control](/modules/segmented-control) (Actions): A mutually exclusive option switcher with a sliding selection pill.
- [Link](/modules/link) (Actions): Themed inline and standalone links with an external indicator.
- [Toggle](/modules/toggle) (Actions): A pressed-state button for binary preferences in toolbars and filter rows.
- [Toolbar](/modules/toolbar) (Actions): A horizontal action bar with grouped controls and hairline separators.
- [Split Button](/modules/split-button) (Actions): A primary action joined to a menu of related alternatives.
- [Field](/modules/field) (Forms): A deep form seam that connects labels, descriptions, errors, and required state.
- [Input and TextArea](/modules/input) (Forms): Native text controls with Teal sizing, invalid states, and forwarded refs.
- [Select](/modules/select) (Forms): An accessible single-value picker with keyboard navigation, typeahead, and collision-aware positioning.
- [Checkbox](/modules/checkbox) (Forms): Boolean and indeterminate selection with an integrated label and description.
- [Switch](/modules/switch) (Forms): An immediate boolean setting with explicit labeling and controlled or uncontrolled state.
- [Radio Group](/modules/radio-group) (Forms): A single-choice option set with an integrated label, description, and subtle borders.
- [Slider](/modules/slider) (Forms): A numeric value scrubber with an optional live value readout.
- [Search Input](/modules/search-input) (Forms): A text field with a leading search affordance, clear action, and loading state.
- [Combobox](/modules/combobox) (Forms): A filterable single-value picker combining free text with a suggestion list.
- [Multi Select](/modules/multi-select) (Forms): A filterable picker for several values, shown as removable pills.
- [Date Picker](/modules/date-picker) (Forms): A single-date field with a keyboard-navigable calendar popover.
- [Number Input](/modules/number-input) (Forms): A numeric field with stepper buttons and min/max clamping.
- [Password Input](/modules/password-input) (Forms): A secret field with an accessible visibility toggle.
- [File Upload](/modules/file-upload) (Forms): A drag-and-drop zone with a browse action and a removable file list.
- [PIN Input](/modules/pin-input) (Forms): A segmented one-time code field with per-cell navigation, paste support, and masking.
- [Tags Input](/modules/tags-input) (Forms): A token entry field that turns typed text into removable chips.
- [Input Group](/modules/input-group) (Forms): An input joined with leading or trailing addons such as protocols and units.
- [Editable](/modules/editable) (Forms): Click-to-edit text that commits on Enter or blur and cancels with Escape.
- [Time Picker](/modules/time-picker) (Forms): A segmented hour and minute field with 12- and 24-hour cycles.
- [Date Range Picker](/modules/date-range-picker) (Forms): A two-click range field with presets and a keyboard-navigable calendar popover.
- [Color Picker](/modules/color-picker) (Forms): A swatch trigger with preset colors and a validated hex field.
- [Card](/modules/card) (Surfaces): A structural surface for related content without ambiguous interactive behavior.
- [Launcher Card](/modules/launcher-card) (Surfaces): An interactive application destination card with an icon, description, optional status, and an honest unavailable state.
- [Badge](/modules/badge) (Surfaces): A compact semantic status indicator using canonical information variants.
- [Accordion](/modules/accordion) (Surfaces): A stacked disclosure list with single and multi-open modes driven by a compact item interface.
- [Chip](/modules/chip) (Surfaces): A compact filter or selection token with an optional remove affordance.
- [Kbd](/modules/kbd) (Surfaces): An inline keyboard shortcut hint with a raised keycap treatment.
- [Scroll Area](/modules/scroll-area) (Surfaces): A scrollable region with styled, theme-consistent scrollbars.
- [Code Block](/modules/code-block) (Surfaces): A code panel with a language label, optional line numbers, and copy-to-clipboard.
- [Dialog](/modules/dialog) (Overlays): A modal surface that owns focus management, naming, dismissal, and scroll locking.
- [Tooltip](/modules/tooltip) (Overlays): A short contextual hint with accessible trigger association and collision handling.
- [Menu](/modules/menu) (Overlays): A structured action menu with keyboard navigation, disabled items, icons, and danger styling.
- [Popover](/modules/popover) (Overlays): An anchored surface for arbitrary controls and supplemental content.
- [Drawer](/modules/drawer) (Overlays): A slide-over panel for focused side tasks, built on the dialog focus model.
- [Hover Card](/modules/hover-card) (Overlays): A rich preview surface revealed on hover or focus, for context without navigation.
- [Command](/modules/command) (Overlays): A command palette dialog with grouped, filterable actions and keyboard navigation.
- [Alert Dialog](/modules/alert-dialog) (Overlays): A blocking confirmation that holds focus until an explicit choice is made.
- [Popconfirm](/modules/popconfirm) (Overlays): A lightweight anchored confirmation for small destructive or irreversible actions.
- [Context Menu](/modules/context-menu) (Overlays): A right-click action menu attached to any element, sharing the Menu item contract.
- [Tour](/modules/tour) (Overlays): A guided walkthrough that highlights target elements step by step.
- [Toast](/modules/toast) (Feedback): Imperative, announced feedback with semantic variants, optional actions, and dismissal.
- [Empty State](/modules/empty-state) (Feedback): An explanatory empty result with an optional action and SVG icon.
- [Loading](/modules/loading) (Feedback): Named progress and loading treatments for local, skeleton, and full-surface states.
- [Alert](/modules/alert) (Feedback): An inline feedback banner with semantic variants, an optional title, and dismissal.
- [Notification Item](/modules/notification-item) (Feedback): A sanitized ecosystem inbox row with severity, source application, read state, deep link, and delivery-state controls.
- [Health Indicator](/modules/health-indicator) (Feedback): An explicit ecosystem health status that reports unknown and stale evidence instead of implying health.
- [Step-Up Notice](/modules/step-up-notice) (Feedback): An inline warning that explains a required fresh verification and hosts the caller’s verification action.
- [Banner](/modules/banner) (Feedback): A page-level notice strip for workspace-wide feedback that owns the top of a view.
- [Progress Circle](/modules/progress-circle) (Feedback): A radial progress indicator with determinate and indeterminate modes.
- [Timeline](/modules/timeline) (Feedback): A vertical activity feed with tone dots, connectors, and timestamps.
- [Meter](/modules/meter) (Feedback): A scalar gauge for a known range with optimum-zone coloring.
- [Rating](/modules/rating) (Feedback): A star rating input with radio semantics, arrow keys, and a read-only display mode.
- [Announcer](/modules/announcer) (Feedback): A visually hidden live region that re-announces a message whenever it changes.
- [App Switcher](/modules/app-switcher) (Navigation): An entitlement-filtered application switcher with an explicit Home destination and keyboard navigation.
- [Account Menu](/modules/account-menu) (Navigation): A household account menu with an identity header, product items, and distinct app and SSO sign-out actions.
- [Tabs](/modules/tabs) (Navigation): Keyboard-navigable content switching through a compact item interface.
- [Pagination](/modules/pagination) (Navigation): A controlled page navigator with compact ranges and unavailable directions.
- [Page Header](/modules/page-header) (Navigation): A responsive page title, supporting text, and action area.
- [Vertical Nav](/modules/vertical-nav) (Navigation): A compound vertical navigation with icon-rail and full-text modes.
- [Nav Rail](/modules/nav-rail) (Navigation): A fully rounded floating icon rail for dense product navigation.
- [Side Rail](/modules/side-rail) (Navigation): A floating glass rail that expands from an icon strip to a full label list on hover or focus.
- [Top Bar](/modules/top-bar) (Navigation): A sticky top bar with brand, search, and action slots.
- [Breadcrumb](/modules/breadcrumb) (Navigation): A hierarchical trail with router-ready items and automatic middle-item collapse.
- [Steps](/modules/steps) (Navigation): A numbered flow indicator with done, current, and upcoming states.
- [Tree View](/modules/tree-view) (Navigation): A hierarchical disclosure list with keyboard navigation and selection.
- [Menubar](/modules/menubar) (Navigation): An application command bar of labeled dropdown menus with full keyboard navigation.
- [Navigation Menu](/modules/navigation-menu) (Navigation): A top-level navigation bar mixing links with rich content panels in a shared viewport.
- [Back Top](/modules/back-top) (Navigation): A floating button that appears after scrolling and returns to the top of the page.
- [Permission Matrix](/modules/permission-matrix) (Data): A people-by-applications access matrix with caller-supplied cell content and explicit no-access cells.
- [Table](/modules/table) (Data): Accessible data presentation driven by column definitions, density, loading, and empty state.
- [Separator](/modules/separator) (Data): A semantic or decorative divider for related content.
- [Avatar](/modules/avatar) (Data): A compact identity image with initials and icon fallbacks.
- [Description List](/modules/description-list) (Data): A label/value definition list for detail pages, stacked or two-column.
- [Data Table](/modules/data-table) (Data): A data grid with sortable columns and row selection, built on the Table contract.
- [Avatar Group](/modules/avatar-group) (Data): An overlapping identity stack with an overflow count.
- [Stat](/modules/stat) (Data): A labeled metric with a trend delta and optional supporting content.
- [List](/modules/list) (Data): A vertical item list with leading and trailing slots, secondary text, and a dense mode.
- [Sparkline](/modules/sparkline) (Data): A tiny inline trend chart in line, area, or bar form with an accessible summary.
- [Calendar](/modules/calendar) (Data): A month grid for picking a single date with bounds and disabled days.
- [Result](/modules/result) (Data): A full-area outcome state for success, error, and HTTP results with a standard icon and actions.
- [Stack](/modules/stack) (Layout): A flex primitive that stacks children along one axis with consistent spacing and alignment.
- [Grid](/modules/grid) (Layout): A grid primitive with fixed columns or responsive auto-fit tracks.
- [Resizable](/modules/resizable) (Layout): Pointer- and keyboard-resizable panes with percentage sizing and double-click reset.
- [Aspect Ratio](/modules/aspect-ratio) (Layout): Keeps media or content at a consistent width-to-height ratio.
- [Visually Hidden](/modules/visually-hidden) (Utilities): Hides content visually while keeping it available to assistive technology.
- [Copy Button](/modules/copy-button) (Utilities): A button that copies a value to the clipboard and confirms with an icon swap and live feedback.
- [Theme Toggle](/modules/theme-toggle) (Utilities): An icon button that toggles the dark class on the document root and reports its state.
- [Carousel](/modules/carousel) (Utilities): A scroll-snap carousel with previous and next controls, dot indicators, and arrow-key support.

## Patterns

- [Recipes](/recipes): product compositions built from published modules.
